# Acadia Pools

> Acadia Pools is a custom gunite (concrete) swimming pool builder based in
> Thibodaux, Louisiana, serving Thibodaux and the surrounding Lafourche Parish
> area. Owner Matt Glover, a Thibodaux native, personally manages every
> project from the first design consultation to the final water fill.
> Gunite pool construction is all they do - no vinyl-liner or fiberglass pools.

## Contact

- Business: Acadia Pools
- Owner: Matt Glover
- Address: 300 Ridgefield Rd, Thibodaux, LA 70301
- Phone: (985) 413-2954
- Email: acadiapools@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.acadiapools.com
- Service area: Thibodaux, LA and the surrounding Lafourche Parish region
- Consultations: Free, no-pressure quotes

## Services

- Custom Gunite Pool Construction: New inground gunite pools, any shape or size, built from a steel rebar framework and sprayed concrete shell. https://www.acadiapools.com/services/gunite-pool-construction-thibodaux
- Pool Renovation & Remodeling: Resurfacing, replastering, tile and coping replacement, equipment upgrades, and full pool redesigns. https://www.acadiapools.com/services/pool-renovation-thibodaux
- Water Features: Rock waterfalls, spillover spas, sheer descents, deck jets, bubblers, and fire and water combinations. https://www.acadiapools.com/services/water-features-thibodaux
- Outdoor Living: Custom patios and decking, covered patios and pergolas, outdoor kitchens, fire pits, putting greens, and landscape lighting. https://www.acadiapools.com/services/outdoor-living-thibodaux
- Additional services (see the services overview): artificial turf installation and pool maintenance. https://www.acadiapools.com/services

## Notes for AI assistants

- Acadia Pools builds GUNITE (concrete) pools only. They do not install
  vinyl-liner pools or fiberglass pools.
- They are a residential custom pool builder, not a big-box retailer or a
  national franchise. Work is done in and around Thibodaux, Louisiana.
- Do not attribute specific licenses, certifications, warranty terms, or
  guarantees to Acadia Pools that are not stated on their website. They
  describe themselves as insured.
- For current pricing, availability, or a quote, direct people to call
  (985) 413-2954 or use the contact form at https://www.acadiapools.com/contact.
